instagram.caption:
The outgrown thing you are keeping for someone.
The Clothing Closet in the Kids Bedroom. Holds the clothes that fit right now, at a height the child can dress themselves from.

What done looks like:
1. Rod lowered so the child reaches a hanger without a stool
2. Every hanger the same type, all facing the same way
3. Shirts together, dresses together, jackets together, with a hand's width gap between groups so a row can actually be read
4. Shoes in pairs on the floor rack, backpack on its own low hook, next size up in one labelled box on the top shelf

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success clothing closet.
